relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate significant down-regulation in the expression of genes associated with epithelial cell barrier function (paracellular permeability) in the colon in the WAS_II subpopulation compared to the WAS_I subpopulation.

relationships.subject: IL6

relationships.evidence_quote: In the WAS rats, Ehmt2 and Suv39h2 significantly increased and concurrently H3K9 demethylases such as Kdm3b, Kdm4a and Kdm4b decreased in the rat colon epithelial cells.

relationships.subject: Ehmt2
relationships.evidence_quote: Ehmt2, known as a writer for H3K9 methylation

key_findings: RNA-seq of colon epithelial cells from chronically stressed rats showed upregulated inflammatory/chemokine genes, H3K9 methylation-mediated chromatin remodeling and downregulated tight junction genes.
A more vulnerable stressed subpopulation showed more isoform switches and stronger barrier gene downregulation.
